text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
These document out outlines the minor maintenance procedure P1, depending on external/internal leakage.
This valve used as fully opening or closing completely (open / closed only 
 state).
Technical Specification:
Type of valve | Ball 
 valves
Size | 8"
Body material | Cast 
 steel
Medium | Water 
 steam
Joint | Flanshed
Packing | Buna non-adjustable
Shaft | Cast 
 steel 316 SS
The first draft initiated by eng. Mahmoud Abou El-Fetouh Shata, tested by 
 eng. Ali Abdel-Salam, revised by eng. Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, accepted by general 
 director eng. Yosry Abdel-Maqsood, and approved by eng. Fathy Ragap head 
 sector of Talkha Power Station.
This document is accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
Planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, earplug, gloves ... etc
Isolate valve mechanically.
Drain the pipeline, which connected to this valve.
Complete 
 maintenance tool set.
Spanner, 
 gasket, spacer ring.
Cleaning 
 liquid.
Blanco, anti 
 seize.
Work to be Carried Out
Be sure the valve was out of operation and the pressure inside the 
 pipeline connected to the valve must be zero from the two end of the valve.
Be sure the pipeline is drained.
Clean from foreign material.
Lap the disk wear or cracks or change the defect disk.
Change the bearing if it is bad.
Make machining for stem or replace the defect.
Replace the pen if it is wear.
Retighten the gland if it is leakage or replace it.
